strategies.statement: Cloud-native first — every new application is designed for the cloud operating model, regardless of where it ultimately runs
strategies.driver: Cloud-native patterns (containers, immutability, observability, declarative infrastructure) are now the baseline expectation for operability
strategies.target-outcome: 100% of new applications cloud-native by 2025; legacy estate reduced 50% by 2027

strategies.statement: Buy or assemble for commodity capability; build only where it differentiates
strategies.driver: Custom-built commodity systems consume disproportionate maintenance budget vs. the differentiation they provide
strategies.target-outcome: Custom-build share of total portfolio below 40% by 2027; build effort concentrated on differentiating capabilities

strategies.statement: Compose capabilities from independent, replaceable services — monoliths are exceptions
strategies.driver: Monolithic applications concentrate risk and constrain pace; composable architectures enable independent evolution
strategies.target-outcome: No new monoliths approved; existing monoliths have a documented decomposition plan or sunset date

strategies.statement: Continuous delivery is the default operating model
strategies.driver: Release-cycle batching hides quality problems and slows learning
strategies.target-outcome: All applications deploy on demand via automated pipelines by 2026; release calendars retired

strategies.statement: Observability is a first-class capability — applications expose health, behaviour, and business signals
strategies.driver: Incidents in unobservable systems cost disproportionately to investigate
strategies.target-outcome: Standard observability (logs / metrics / traces) on every production service; business-outcome telemetry on every customer-facing flow

strategies.statement: Polyglot persistence — match the data store to the workload, not vice versa
strategies.driver: A single shared database constrains every service to its lowest-common-denominator capability
strategies.target-outcome: Each service owns its primary data store, selected for fit; canonical data published as products (per DAT)

activity.notes: Reviewed and refined during the 2026-Q1 architecture cycle.
